title: Great for the bride to be or first time homeowner
text: Great for the bride to be or first time homeowner. The Paula Deen cookware set makes a great, reasonably priced set of cookware for a shower or housewarming present. Although I honestly don't think this set will hold up as well as my Calphalon set (I don't think I would be subjecting these pots to a dishwasher), I believe that for someone starting out (and for less than $100), this set makes a great affordable (and impressive gift). I would be careful using any sharp objects in the cookware as it does scratch easily. However, with using soft spatulas, this set should hold up for years of normal household use. And the name (Paula Deen) makes it a recognizable set to give as an impressive gift.

product_metadata.title: Paula Deen Signature Stainless Steel Cookware Pots and Pans Set, 12 Piece
features: SET INCLUDES: 1-Quart, 2-Quart, and 3-Quart Saucepans with Lids, 6-Quart Stockpot with Lid, 8-Inch and 10-Inch Nonstick Frying Pans, Slotted Turner. Slotted Spoon
STAINLESS STEEL COOKWARE WITH COPPER ACCENTS: The cookware set's pots and pans are made of durable stainless steel with copper accents
TIGHT FITTING, SEE-THRU LIDS: Glass lids allow cooking to be monitored without losing heat or moisture, and copper-accented knobs are easy to grab
HIGH CONTROL HANDLES: Dual-riveted, soft-touch cookware handles are designed to provide a comfortable, secure grip
NONSTICK SUITABLE: Pots and pans come with two nylon kitchen tools, and frying pans are coated with top-quality nonstick for effortless food release and easy cleanup
OVEN SAFE COOKWARE: Stainless steel cookware set is oven safe to 350° F LIFETIME LIMITED WARRANTY
description: Inspired by Paula's collection of Southern heirloom cookware, this Paula Deen Signature Stainless Steel 12-Piece Cookware Set provides warmth and tradition to kitchens everywhere. Featuring 1-quart saucepan, 2-quart saucepan and 3-quart saucepan with lids, a 6-quart stockpot with lid, and 8-inch nonstick frying pan and 10-inch nonstick frying pans, the cookware set features stainless steel construction for beautiful, durable cookware. The fry pan interiors are coated with top-quality nonstick so tasty recipes of all kinds release easily and are left intact for impressive presentation. Stainless steel cookware handles feature a soft-touch coating for a comfortable grip, and are dual riveted to the cookware for extra strength. The handles are also accented with copper-plated hanging rings so these striking pieces can be displayed with pride in any size kitchen. Glass lids seal in heat and flavor and are topped with knobs that are easy to grasp and stylishly decorated with copper. This cookware is oven safe to 350°F, perfect for recipes that require the cooktop and oven. Accent the home kitchen with a touch of copper, with the beautiful, high-polished Paula Deen Signature Stainless Steel 12-Piece Cookware Set.
